text:
maria: fyi - we're seeing an uptick of ECC corrected errors and 7 XIDs over 4m on us-west2-rack14-node3. healthscore ~0.74. telemetry also shows a small pcie_err rise. thinking a soft-isolate chain first so we don't nuke long slurm runs.
oncall-bot: [ALERT] gpu-telemetry: node=us-west2-rack14-node3 metric=eccevents xids=7 window=240s health=0.74 runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-triage
deepak: I agree with soft isolation. New pattern we've used: mark node with ephemeral-taint, set slurm to DRAIN_SLOW (lets running jobs finish but blocks new ones), start BMC snapshot + nvme health check. If signals persist >15m escalate.

oliver: Before we do anything, what's spare capacity in us-west2? If we're down to <8 spare GPUs a cordon will push latency. Also prefer cross-region spillover over immediate hard-evict for inference pools.
kai: Capacity note: us-west2 pool has 5 spare GPUs and 2 preemptible on-call slots. If we soft-isolate now queue delay will be ~90s for batch, ~3-4s for prod inference if we allow prioritization. Hard-evict will force heavier spillover to hosted and increase egress/cost.
sysops: Starting BMC snapshot and collecting dmesg + nvme SMART. Scheduling soft reset attempt in 3m if taint doesn't calm it.

maria: proposing commands for soft flow - non-blocking and reversible:
```
# mark node to avoid new scheduling, keep existing pods until they naturally terminate
kubectl label node us-west2-rack14-node3 infra/redwood=ephemeral-taint --overwrite
kubectl taint nodes us-west2-rack14-node3 gpu.flaky=ephemeral:NoSchedule --overwrite
# slurm: drain slowly so current jobs finish, don't preempt
scontrol update NodeName=us-west2-rack14-node3 State=DRAIN Reason="soft-isolate:gpu-health"
```

deepak: also adding an auto-drainer policy snippet (yaml) to the config store - requires 2-signal corroboration by default: xids+pcie OR xids+temp OR xids+nvlink. Only single-XID spikes get an extended watch and soft-isolate, not hard-evict.
```
auto_drainer:
  triggers:
    - name: xid_pcie_correlate
      signals: [xid_count, pcie_err]
      window_s: 900
      soft_action: [ephemeral_taint, slurm_drain_slow]
      hard_action: [cordon, evict, queue_replacement_ticket]
      escalation_delay_s: 900
      skip_if_job_tag: [nonpreemptible, safepreserve]
```

oliver: +1. Also include a regional-splay rule: if region spare_gpus < 6 then attempt to drain to nearest region with capacity before hard-evict. That reduces chance of mass fallback to hosted.

kai: adding cost guardrail: emit billing alert if hosted-fallback routing causes > $1200/hr additional spend or >3 replacements in 60m.

maria: running soft-isolate now. will monitor for 15m window. Notifying hw-team.
slurm-bot: [slurm] Node us-west2-rack14-node3 change -> DRAIN (soft) Reason: soft-isolate:gpu-health
sysops: BMC snapshot complete, nvme SMART OK, performed host power-cycle. No firmware pushes in last 24h on this rack. PCIe link flaps recorded at t0+30s.

maria: After 11m we still see XID activity (2 more) and pcie_err count climbed. Soft-isolate didn't stabilize. Jobs drained cleanly (no safepreserve flagged). Preparing escalation.

deepak: Given corroboration (xid+pice) and emptying of jobs, escalate to hard flow: cordon + evict with 60s grace for pods and create replacement ticket. Also attach logs to ticket automatically.

maria: Hard-action commands staged (will run now):
```
# hard cordon + force-evict
kubectl cordon us-west2-rack14-node3
kubectl delete pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=us-west2-rack14-node3 --grace-period=60 --force=false
scontrol update NodeName=us-west2-rack14-node3 State=DOWN Reason=auto-evict-correlated
# queue replacement with logs attached
POST /infra/api/tickets {"node":"us-west2-rack14-node3","type":"board_replace","priority":"high","attachments":["dmesg.log","nvidia-smi-q.txt","telemetry-window.json"]}
```

slurm-bot: [slurm] Node us-west2-rack14-node3 state change: DRAIN -> DOWN

sysops: Eviction executed. Node removed from k8s schedulers. Replacement ticket INFRA-9217 created and assigned to hw-team.
hw-team: ACK. We'll attempt remote diagnostics + RMA next business slot. If onsite swap needed we'll schedule earliest window.

oliver: Follow-up: tweak auto-drainer to include a cooldown per-rack (12h) and a regional-splay threshold to avoid simultaneous replacements across same rack. Also expose a dashboard metric auto_evictions_per_hour by region.
kai: I'll add that metric and a spend alert for hosted-fallback. Also recommend a 'soft-fallback-first' policy for inference that prefers routing a percentage (20%) to regional spare before full spillover.

maria: Attached logs to ticket and documenting sequence in incident notes. Closing loop once hw-team confirms board swap or RMA success.
oncall-bot: [CLOSE] gpu-health-us-west2-rack14-node3 incident closed by maria at 1937656123
